chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. 'Ali b. Asad al-Asadi narrated to us in Ray in Rajab 347. He said: ... from Umm al-Darda' from Abu'l Darda'. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Whoever awakes with a healthy body, safe in his path, having the provision of his day, then it is as if the whole world has been given to him. O Ibn Ja'sham! It suffices you from it that which stops your hunger and covers your nakedness.

If you have a house that shelters you, then that is good. And if you have a beast to ride, then bravo! But if not, then bread and water from the jar. Whatever is beyond that is reckoning upon you or punishment.

key_terms.قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ: Daily provision, the sustenance of one's day
key_terms.مُعَافًى: In good health, well-being of the body

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about contentment with basic provisions?
ai.summary: The Prophet taught that one who wakes up healthy, safe, and with enough provision for the day has been given the equivalent of the entire world. He counseled contentment with basic needs: food, clothing, shelter, and transport, warning that anything beyond necessities brings accountability.
